text: In Accendura, a small village in Basilicata, [boys begin to vanish and turn up dead|wrong|harm done to children], and reporters converge on a community riddled with superstition and mistrust. Suspicion falls first on the simpleton Giuseppe, then on Maciara, a reclusive witch in the hills who [plunges pins through clay dolls|images|dolls, masks and likenesses] and is soon [beaten to death by a group of men|threat|the group turns on you]. The Roman journalist Andrea Martelli and [Patrizia, a city woman the villagers shun|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised], follow the clues toward a deaf-mute girl who pulls the heads off her dolls.
